In the recent months, large amounts of non-muslim resistance have cropped up around various towns in Sal-Baliz territory. So far, nothing had been done about it, because the supreme leader feared that doing so too obviously would bring the might of THEP crashing down on them even harder than before, but now a perfect opportunity had arisen. Poison the water supply. Soon, tonnes of uranium was being pumped into water around the Sal-Baliz. Within a few days, entire towns were dead.
